name: Jajas
source:
"Hey there, you lady-killer! You’re just too smooth, nya~!"

A winged cat stuffed animal that follows Maya and guides Nayuta. Mischievous and energetic, it usually plays the role of straight man to Marineo’s jokes. Its way of speaking always ends with “nya,” giving it a playful, catlike tone.
